CORE MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #18
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: CORE MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x
   B. 12x + 2
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x

2. Find the GCD of 43 and 55. (1 mark)
   A. 43
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

3. Solve for x: x + 4 = 15. (1 mark)
   A. 15
   B. 11
   C. 12
   D. 4

4. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 9
   C. 18
   D. 82

5. Which inequality means “x is greater than 5”? (1 mark)
   A. x > 5
   B. x < 5
   C. x = 5
   D. x ≥ 0 only

6. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 26
   B. 13
   C. 169
   D. 170

7. Which is greater: 1/4 or 1/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/2
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 1/4

8. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

9. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 37
   C. 1
   D. 1

10. What is √25? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 6
   C. 5
   D. 12.5

11. Find the GCD of 25 and 37. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 1
   C. 2
   D. 25

12. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 81
   D. 90

13. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 49

14. What is 4 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 10
   C. 2
   D. 24

15. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 7
   C. 14
   D. 50

16. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 45
   B. 18
   C. 30
   D. 36

17. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 27.6
   B. 33
   C. 27.7
   D. 27

18. What is 8 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 15
   C. 56
   D. 57

19. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 7
   C. 13
   D. 15

20. What is 8 × 5? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 40
   C. 41
   D. 13

21. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 40
   C. 10
   D. 400

22. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 12
   C. 4
   D. 32

23. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 12
   C. 42
   D. 36

24. Find the GCD of 31 and 43. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 2
   C. 31
   D. 1

25. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 8
   D. 17

26. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 72
   C. 73
   D. 17

27. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121

   C. 11
   D. 22

28. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 4
   C. 400
   D. 10

29. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 144

30. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 3 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 28
   C. 33
   D. 22
